colors.name: Electric Indigo
colors.role: Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Obsidian
colors.role: Page canvas, deepest background - the void that all content sits on

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Elevated surface, product preview frames, secondary panels

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Deeper overlay surface, hover states on dark cards, input fields

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Primary text, inverted surface, button text, high-contrast foreground

colors.name: Silver
colors.role: Hairline borders, dividers, subtle structural edges

colors.name: Pearl
colors.role: Secondary text, subdued headings, placeholder body copy

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Footer borders, low-contrast dividers between dark zones

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Muted helper text, inactive icons, de-emphasized metadata

fonts.name: Savee Font
fonts.role: The sole typeface - a custom geometric sans used at every scale. Weight 400 carries the editorial body and nav; weight 500 appears on buttons and emphasized labels. The 96px display at 0.96 line-height with -0.04em tracking is the system's signature: it compresses into a dense confident block rather than stretching vertically, making the headline feel sculptural.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.role: The sole filled action in the system

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.role: Secondary action that doesn't compete with the primary

components.name: Display Headline
components.role: Hero-level typography that defines the page

components.name: Editorial Body Block
components.role: Long-form persuasive text at unusual scale

components.name: Product Preview Frame
components.role: Large product screenshot or video container below the hero

do: Use #1500ff Electric Indigo exclusively for the single primary CTA on any given screen - never for secondary actions, links, icons, or decorative elements
Set display headlines at 96px with line-height 0.96 and letter-spacing -0.04em so the type compresses into a confident sculptural block rather than stretching
Apply 9999px border-radius to every button, tag, and pill - the pill shape is the system's only control geometry
Use 14px radius for card and product preview surfaces, and nothing else - keep the shape vocabulary to exactly two radii
Let the Obsidian canvas (#050505) be the separator between sections - add 64-80px of empty space rather than lines, color shifts, or gradient transitions
Set body prose at 36px when it needs to carry editorial weight; drop to 18px for functional descriptions. Never use 14-16px for primary page copy
Keep all text in the neutral palette (#fdfdfd, #d4d4d4, #a3a3a3) - the only chromatic color is the CTA indigo
doNot: Never use #1500ff for anything other than the primary CTA fill - not for links, not for icons, not for hover states, not for badges
Never add drop shadows or elevation glows to cards - the system uses surface color shifts (#050505 #151515 #1e1e1e) for hierarchy, not shadows
Never set body text below 16px for primary content - captions and metadata can go to 13-14px, but main copy stays large
Never introduce additional accent colors, even in illustrations or partner logos - the partner strip stays grayscale to preserve the indigo's dominance
Never use border-radius values between 0px and 9999px for buttons - the system is binary: fully rounded pills or 14px card corners, nothing in between
Never apply gradients to backgrounds, buttons, or text - the system is flat monochrome with one solid color exception
Never use line-height above 1.50 for any text size - the tight line-heights (0.96-1.38) are the system's editorial signature
